Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can.  In such cases, you can't add a card from your security stack to your hand, therefore you place a specified card as the top or bottom security card.
Card Q&A.q: Can I also activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect when I have 0 cards in my security stack?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, you may place 1 [Angel], [Archangel], [Three Great Angels] or [Iliad] trait Digimon card or 1 [TS] trait Tamer card from your hand as the top or bottom security card.
